info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Careers Applications Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Status API allows users to retrieve the status of job applications submitted through the organization's career portal. This endpoint provides essential insights into the progression of applications, helping candidates stay informed about their application outcomes. Typical consumers of this API include job applicants, recruitment teams, and HR professionals looking to enhance the candidate experience. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline communication and update applicants in real-time regarding their application status.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the real-time status of all applications, providing insights into their current state and any relevant information. Use this to monitor application performance or troubleshoot issues.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of applications. Ensure that the correct parameters are provided to get the desired application status.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current application status.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body that should be sent in JSON format when querying the status of applications. It typically contains a summary or identifier as a string.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the application.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

audit.description: Information regarding the auditing of the application status.

ListCareersApplicationsStatusResponse_20.description: Response schema for the status of applications retrieved via GET operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit entry was created by an automated process.

Audit.description: Audit information for the application status.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that it took to process the request.
